# NMRiH2 Guide

> An independent, evidence-first guide to No More Room in Hell 2 for English-speaking players.

NMRiH2 Guide explains current-version game systems, squad decisions, equipment, and maps. Official release notes and game descriptions are the primary source for mechanics. Community-tested advice is clearly labeled and requires independent, current sources before it is recommended.

## Core guides

- [Start here](https://nmrih2guide.com/)
- [Beginner survival guide](https://nmrih2guide.com/beginner-guide/)
- [Infection survival guide](https://nmrih2guide.com/infection/)
- [Weapons and ammo guide](https://nmrih2guide.com/weapons/)
- [Loadout planning guide](https://nmrih2guide.com/loadouts/)
- [Objective and Survival maps guide](https://nmrih2guide.com/maps/)
